# Pull request template

Thanks for your contribution. Please fill in the sections below.

## Description

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Docs / repository maintenance only (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)

## Checklist

- [ ] Application behaviour is unchanged (no application code changed).
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally (`python -m pytest -q`).
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] Commit messages use Conventional Commits (`docs:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).

## Related issue

Link to the issue this PR addresses, if any.
